headline: Pension Commission approved fund changes, added two funds to watch list, and voted to rebalance portfolio to target allocation.
summary: The commission reviewed the Town's 457 plan and pension plan performance for the quarter ending June 30, 2026. Members voted to place two funds on a watch list, replace two funds in the portfolio, and rebalance the portfolio to target allocation.
decisions: Placed MFS Growth R6 and JPMorgan Mid Cap Value R6 on the Quantitative Watch List.
Replaced Wasatch Core Growth Institutional with MassMutual Small Cap Gr Eq1.
Replaced Conestoga Small Cap Institutional with Drieshaus Small Cap Growth Institutional.
Rebalanced the portfolio to target allocation.

decision_evidence.quote: a motion was made by Mr. Camelio, seconded by Mr. Blanchard to place MFS Growth R6 and JPMorgan Mid Cap Value R6 on the Quantitative Watch List. Motion approved unanimously.
a motion was made by Mr. Blanchard, seconded by Mr. Camelio to replace Wasatch Core Growth Institutional with MassMutual Small Cap Gr Eq1. Motion approved unanimously.
a motion was made by Mr. Blanchard, seconded by Mr. Camelio to replace Conestoga Small Cap Institutional with Drieshaus Small Cap Growth Institutional. Motion approved unanimously.
a motion was made by Mr. Sena, seconded by Mr. Raddatz to rebalance the portfolio to target allocation. Motion approved unanimously.
